name: miaoda-game-fsm-core
description: Engine-agnostic finite state machine for game logic — enemy AI (patrol/chase/attack), character states (idle/run/jump), game flow (menu/playing/paused). enter/exit/update hooks, declarative guarded transitions, timeInState. The gameplay-level FSM Cocos doesn't ship (Marionette is animation-only). No rendering, no engine dependency.
